flow.name: order-notify-recipients
flow.doc:description: Recipient list: computes from an order which downstream systems must be notified (invoicing, warehouse, digital delivery, customs) and sends the order to each of them over HTTP.

logger.doc:name: INFO: Log notification request
logger.message: #['Notify recipients of orderId=' ++ (payload.orderId default 'none') ++ ', correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

when.expression: #[(not (payload is Object)) or isEmpty(payload.orderId) or isEmpty(payload.country) or (not (payload.items is Array)) or isEmpty(payload.items) or not isEmpty(payload.items filter (not (['PHYSICAL', 'DIGITAL'] contains $.'type')))]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise BAD_REQUEST Error - Missing order fields
raise-error.description: orderId, country and a non-empty items array, each item of type PHYSICAL or DIGITAL, are required

logger.doc:name: WARN: Log failed delivery
logger.message: #['Recipient ' ++ vars.vRecipient ++ ' did not receive orderId=' ++ vars.vOrder.orderId ++ ' (' ++ error.errorType.namespace ++ ':' ++ error.errorType.identifier ++ '), correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

set-variable.doc:name: SET vDeliveries
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- vars.vDeliveries ++ [{ recipient: vars.vRecipient, status: 'FAILED', errorType: error.errorType.namespace ++ ':' ++ error.errorType.identifier }]]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { orderId: vars.vOrder.orderId, recipients: vars.vRecipients, deliveries: vars.vDeliveries, allDelivered: isEmpty(vars.vDeliveries filter ($.status != "DELIVERED")) }

logger.doc:name: INFO: Log notification result
logger.message: #['Order ' ++ payload.orderId ++ ' sent to ' ++ (vars.vRecipients joinBy ',') ++ ', allDelivered=' ++ payload.allDelivered ++ ', correlationId=' ++ correlationId]
